title: Water Treatment Operations Supervisor Plant Manager
text:
**Join Inframark:** Leading the Way in Water Management
 
Inframark's Operations and Maintenance team is an award-winning team that delivers cutting-edge water, wastewater, and public works services to municipalities, utility districts, and industries. We are dedicated to supporting our employees as well as protecting the environment and the communities we serve. You would be empowered to thrive in a dynamic, supportive, and innovative environment. Take the next step in your career and join us at Inframark. Apply today!
 
Why Work for Inframark?
 
 
Our dedication to sustainability and community impact drives us to ensure clean, safe water for future generations. Whether you're at the start of your career or looking for advancement, Inframark offers purpose-driven work and opportunities for growth. We offer an attractive salary package, including a generous benefits package with health, dental, and life insurance, 401(k) plan, paid time off, sick leave, holidays, and wellness plan.
 
 
Water Operations Supervisor
 
Jasper GA
 
Are you an experienced water professional ready to take the next step in leadership? We are seeking a Water Operations Supervisor to oversee the day-to-day operation, maintenance, and regulatory compliance of our water treatment and distribution systems. In this role, you'll lead a skilled team, ensure safe and efficient plant operations, and play a critical role in delivering high-quality drinking water to the communities we serve.
 
This is an excellent opportunity for a licensed water treatment professional who thrives in a hands-on leadership role and is passionate about operational excellence, team development, and public service.
 
What You'll Do
 
 
**As the Water Operations Supervisor, you will:** 

* Lead the continuous operation of water treatment plants, wells, standpipes, distribution systems, and related infrastructure.
* Supervise and support operations staff, ensuring work is completed safely, efficiently, and in compliance with all regulatory requirements.
* Monitor plant performance and operational processes, making adjustments as needed to maintain system reliability and water quality.
* Prepare and review internal, regulatory, and client reports.
* Verify staff compliance with operational procedures, maintenance programs, laboratory protocols, QA/QC standards, and safety requirements.
* Conduct regular meetings with department leaders to review performance metrics, operational goals, and continuous improvement opportunities.
* Assist in establishing facility objectives, operational strategies, and workforce planning initiatives.
* Respond effectively to emergency situations and implement corrective actions when necessary.
* Champion a strong safety culture by overseeing and enforcing company safety programs and standards.
* Participate in hiring, interviewing, onboarding, coaching, performance evaluations, and disciplinary processes.
* Develop and approve staff schedules to ensure adequate operational coverage.
* Support budgeting, planning, and administrative functions.
* Serve as acting Project Manager when needed.
* Build positive relationships with customers, clients, municipal officials, and community stakeholders.

What We're Looking For
 
Required Qualifications
 

* High school diploma or GED required.
* Additional college coursework or vocational training in chemistry, environmental science, water technology, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of five (5) years of experience in water treatment, water distribution, system maintenance, construction, or related utility operations.
* Class I Water Treatment Plant Operator License (or equivalent license required by the state of employment).
* Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.

Knowledge & Experience
 
 
**Successful candidates will have knowledge of:** 

* Surface water treatment processes and groundwater operations.
* Water quality regulations, permits, and compliance requirements.
* Pumps, motors, valves, engines, and related mechanical equipment.
* Backflow prevention devices and cross-connection control practices.
* Supervising, mentoring, and developing employees.
* Utility operations, maintenance planning, and emergency response procedures.

Skills for Success
 

* Strong leadership and team development capabilities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to evaluate operating parameters and optimize treatment processes.
* Experience operating process control systems and laboratory equipment.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and decision-making abilities.

Work Environment
 
This role combines office responsibilities with field and plant operations. You will work in both indoor and outdoor environments and may be exposed to changing weather conditions, mechanical equipment, chemicals, noise, dust, and other industrial settings. Appropriate safety procedures and personal protective equipment are required.
 
Physical Requirements
 

* Ability to stand, walk, climb, bend, kneel, crouch, and work around operational equipment for extended periods.
* Frequently lift, carry, push, or pull up to 50 pounds.
* Ability to work in confined spaces and elevated areas when required.
* Must be able to distinguish between different shades of color for operational and safety purposes.
* Available to work overtime and respond to emergency situations outside normal business hours, including weekends and holidays when necessary

To support a safe and secure workplace, all offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of background screening, drug testing, and driving record review where applicable.
 
Inframark is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against based on disability.
 
Learn more about us at Operations and Maintenance - Inframark
